module_description: Azure service status: your subscription's Service Health (ARM Resource Health) plus the public Azure status feed.

hints.tenant_id: Entra ID directory (tenant) ID of the app registration.
hints.client_id: Application (client) ID of the app registration.
hints.client_secret: Client secret of the app registration.
hints.subscription_id: Azure subscription to read Service Health from. The app needs an Azure RBAC role assignment (Reader is enough) ON THIS SUBSCRIPTION — an Entra app role does not grant it.
hints.check_service_health: Reads Microsoft.ResourceHealth events: outages, planned maintenance and advisories affecting YOUR resources and regions.
hints.health_window_hours: Only consider events updated within this many hours.
hints.check_public_status: Reads the public Azure status feed. Needs no credentials, but only reports globally announced incidents — it cannot tell whether your resources are affected.
hints.public_filter: Only report entries mentioning this text (e.g. 'West Europe' or 'Storage'). Blank = every entry.

messages.az_no_creds: tenant_id, client_id, client_secret and subscription_id are required
messages.az_health_ok: No active Service Health events in the last {} h
messages.az_public_fail: Could not read the public Azure status feed: {}
messages.az_public_ok: No open entries in the public Azure status feed
messages.az_public_open: {} entries in the public Azure status feed — latest: {}
